title: Lazar held at gunpoint at Indian Springs but never fired

tellings.quote: they bring him to Indian Springs they put a gun to his head

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron passes on what he heard from John Lear, a pilot and UFO enthusiast, about Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. According to Cameron, in 1989 Lazar was taken to Indian Springs, an Air Force base in Nevada, and a gun was put to his head, yet he was never actually fired from the job. If true, it would suggest the people running the work treated what Lazar knew as deadly serious.
